summary: Slack channel lifecycle policy + Confluence template sync automation for Security Pulse & Pod pages
description:
Issue summary:
As part of the Security and Platform pods' operational hygiene work, they want a consolidated admin automation that: (1) enforces a Slack channel lifecycle policy (auto-archive after X days of inactivity with staged notices and an owner ping), (2) syncs a small set of standardized Confluence templates into the 'Security Pulse' and pod spaces when templates are updated, and (3) provisions a lightweight group-sync between GitHub teams and Confluence/Slack membership for oncall and rotation owners.

Impact:
- Manual channel cleanups and template drift are increasing operational overhead for pod leads.
- Security Pulse pages diverge between regions when template updates are applied manually.
- Oncall owners are not consistently mirrored to Slack channel membership, causing missed rotations and paging gaps.

Requested changes (deliverables):
1) Slack automation that:
   - Sends a 30-day inactivity warning to channel (bot message + channel topic update) and pings the channel owner.
   - After 60 days of inactivity, archives the channel and records the archival reason to a central audit Confluence page.
   - Exposes an override for specific channels via a channel tag or an admin allowlist.
2) Confluence template sync job that:
   - Watches the Templates repo (or a canonical Confluence space) for changes and propagates updates to designated spaces (Security Pulse, Platform Pods).
   - Runs weekly with a dry-run report to the template owners and a one-click apply via a Confluence macro.
3) Group membership sync MVP that:
   - Maps GitHub teams (e.g., security-oncall, platform-oncall) to Slack usergroups and Confluence space admin groups.
   - Runs on commit to a central mapping file and provides an audit log of membership changes.

Acceptance criteria:
- Slack channel automated notifications and archival run in staging with test channels and a documented rollback path.
- Confluence template sync can perform dry-run and apply flows; updates are recorded in page history and a weekly summary is sent to template owners.
- Oncall owners in GitHub teams are reflected in Slack usergroups and Confluence admin lists within 10 minutes of the sync job run.
- Audit entries are created for every channel archive and membership change, viewable in the 'Admin Automation Audit' Confluence page.

Timeline and constraints:
- Business wants staging proof-of-concept by end of Q1 (2026-03-31); production rollout early Q2.
- Must respect existing IAM rules; the automation will use a service account with scoped permissions only.
- Compliance note: archived channel content retention must follow legal retention policy; do not delete message history.

Additional context/attachments:
- Pod leads: Security (Marta Anders), Platform (Ravi Desai).
- Existing related admin tickets: INT-13721 (confluence space provisioning), INT-11984 (central docspace lifecycle).
- Proposed owner: Platform Ops (Marcus Liu) with support from Identity team (Leah Kim).

investigation_notes: Checked current slack app marketplace - we have an existing bot 'ops-bot' but it lacks channel archival capability. Building a lightweight lambda-based worker will be faster than purchasing a new app.
Reviewed Confluence API rate limits for our cloud tier. Weekly sync with batched updates should be within quota; will implement exponential backoff and dry-run reports to avoid accidental overwrites.
Validated GitHub team names for pilot: security-oncall-us, platform-oncall-us. Confirmed team membership events are available via webhooks and GitHub Apps API.

Identified required permissions: Slack: channels:manage, channels:read, usergroups:write; Confluence: confluence.space.manage, confluence.content.write; GitHub: read:org/team membership. Service account request ticket drafted to Identity.
resolution_notes: MVP in progress. Next steps: Identity to provision service account with scoped permissions (target 2026-03-17). Platform Ops will deploy Slack archival dry-run to staging (target 2026-03-24). Confluence template sync job queued for weekly run in staging; dry-run reports will be emailed to template owners. Post-deployment tasks: create runbook for overrides and emergency rollback, and add the new audit page. Follow-up ticket will capture production rollout checklist and compliance signoff.
